text: Grand Marshal Aric Thal commands Sentinel High Command within the galactic_union faction; Sentinel-Praetor variant. Distinct office from the Chief Marshal (owner ruling CL-13a).

Operation Silent Dagger (LEDGER-MISSIONS-0001): mission author and lead of the five-operative Sentinel team against Blackreach Station; rogue-AI research facility neutralized, leadership eliminated, intelligence extracted, one operative KIA.
Commands the SHC; advises the Chancellor and Military High Command via direct uplink. Led Serath, Koris, Kael Voss and Darek Voss on Silent Dagger.
Sentinel-Class Power Suit, Praetor variant (battlefield command / "Field Marshal" unit).
